div.head: V Atr 14
div.ab: ⁊ sancte Marian freolstida ealle weorðie man georne ærest mid fæstene ⁊ syððan mid freolse.
⁊ sancte Marian freolstida ealle weorðige man georne ærest mid fæstene ⁊ syððan mid freolse.
And sancta Marian freolstida ealle wurðian man georne, ærest mid fæstene ⁊ siððan mid freolse.
And sancta Marian freolstide ealle wurðian man georne, ærest mid fæstene ⁊ siððan mid freolse.
And sancte Marian freolstida ealle weorðie man georne, ærest mid fæstene and syððan mid freolse.
Und alle Festzeiten der heiligen Maria ehre man willig, zuerst durch Fasten und dann durch Festfeier.
And let all the festivals of St Mary be eagerly honoured, first with fasting and then with feasting.
And all St Mary's festivals shall be zealously honoured, first with fasting and afterwards with festivity.
And all the festivals of St Mary are to be diligently observed, first with a fast and afterwards with a festival.
And each of the Feasts of Saint Mary is to be celebrated faithfully, first with fasting and then with a holiday.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Maria 6; Verkündigung: Piper Kalend. Agsa. 91. 94
Cf. Gl Maria 6; Annunciation: Piper Kalend. Agsa. 91. 94
Cf. VI, 22, 2; I Cn. 16 a. The dates on which these festivals fell were Feb. 2nd, March 25th, August 15th, Sept. 8th (see Piper, Kalend. Agsa., pp. 91, 94).
